detected_fault: Combination of Charging Issue, Slow Response Time, Game Boot Issues, and Random Command Prompt Appearance
suggested_solution: Run a thorough diagnostic test on the laptop to identify the source of the problem.
Check for any BIOS updates and install the latest version.
Verify that the thermal paste is properly applied and consider reapplying it if necessary.
Run stress tests on the graphics card and processor to determine their health.
